name: The Tennis & Pickleball Club at Newport Beach
note: Private members' club: 44 pickleball courts in big pens (royal blue with cyan kitchens on green, pale-blue and salmon feature pods), 12 tennis courts with the only red clay court in Orange County, a green-roofed clubhouse with its lounge and bar, a rooftop terrace bar up the stairs, the social lawn with its outdoor bar, all lit; the golf course all round. Rooms inside the buildings are a reconstruction (docs/pickleball-venues.md).
